verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents in-product AI that analyzes customer data and surfaces actionable findings. Its AI-powered evidence gap analysis checks uploaded evidence for relevance, scope and timeliness, flagging issues such as outdated timestamps or irrelevant screenshots so users can fix them before an audit. It also offers AI-assisted due diligence reviews for AI vendors, and the AI Editor builds ingestion workflows from natural-language prompts. Missing for 10: a general AI assistant or insight layer over compliance posture and dashboard data (insights are limited to specific modules), detail on what suggestions the due-diligence AI produces, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
